fields.name: row_order
fields.type: list[str or bool or int or float] or None

fields.name: col_order
fields.type: list[str or bool or int or float] or None

facets.panel_selector: filters: exact JSON scalar matches on up to two columns
facets.template: one completed unfiltered primary Cartesian2D panel
facets.semantics: pooled original selected row IDs; named shared domains
facets.layout: explicit cells; later edits panel-scoped; size unchanged
facets.data_updates: selectors/orders persist; rebuild to add new levels
facets.limits: no matrices/3D/polar/y2/c colourbars; hist needs typed config and common explicit edges; kde needs KDESpec

joint_grid.marginals: hist count/density/probability/percent, KDE density, or ECDF count/probability/percent
joint_grid.layout: main top-left, y right, x below; no fourth axes
joint_grid.selection: dynamic complete x/y/group cases; source table intact
joint_grid.sharing: x by column, y by row; density axes remain independent
joint_grid.limits: one raw primary Cartesian2D template; no semantics/c/y2/weights; binned centers require no group/hue_order/colourbar

fields.name: hue_order
fields.type: list[str or bool or int or float] or None

pair_grid.cells: raw scatter off diagonal; typed hist/KDE/ECDF diagonal
pair_grid.selection: pairwise complete rows; diagonal variable-only rows
pair_grid.sharing: named x columns/y off-diagonal rows; density y independent
pair_grid.limits: 2..8 numeric vars; categorical group; no corner/weights; ECDF needs non-density stat and unused default bins

named_axis_sharing.limits: primary Cartesian; figure mode none; same scales/limits

heatmap.center: linear diverging TwoSlope; inferred bounds symmetric
heatmap.mask: same-shaped booleans; hidden values excluded from norm/text
heatmap.annotations: raw values/bounded formats; alpha-aware text contrast
heatmap.limits: finite rectangular matrix; no custom text/cluster/date axes

clustermap.orders: fit or supplied linkage; labels/mask/colours follow leaves
clustermap.standardization: row/col sample z-score or min-max, mutually exclusive
clustermap.mask: display only; does not remove fit or standardization values
clustermap.layout: own Cartesian panel; no axis sharing/cropped limits/overlays
clustermap.data: source matrix unchanged; fit-time transformation/order only
clustermap.limits: one colour strip/axis; no missing data/continuous strip legend

stem.orientation: vertical numeric positions and heads; rows unchanged
stem.baseline: raw scalar, default zero; positive on log response axes

stairs.values: x names the supplied height column; bins stores N+1 edges
stairs.geometry: vertical outline, scalar baseline default zero; no rebinning

eventplot.positions: one numeric train, source and duplicate events retained
eventplot.geometry: vertical marks; baseline offset, width length in raw units

broken_barh.limits: linear primary/y2 single band; no date/group/facet mappings

regression.residual: residplot alias; observed y minus in-sample fitted response
regression.grouping: fit after panel/hue selection; source rows retained
regression.weights: LayerSpec.weights; relative poly/logx point fits/raw residuals; zero rows excluded; scaling must remain representable
regression.limits: no weighted CI/robust/logistic/LOWESS; no bootstrap/deviance residuals/residual smooth trend

statistics.axes: Cartesian 2-D primary native/log; legacy linear ordinal y2 only
statistics.stat_scale: raw default; axis log mean/median/min/max + inverse
statistics.log_intervals: SD/SEM/PI/CI in declared space; no endpoint clipping
statistics.baseline: bar/count raw endpoint base; log needs explicit positive base
statistics.bar_endpoint: estimate, not baseline+estimate; labels show estimate
statistics.log_stack: no log values; native/log categories + linear stacks
statistics.native_sizes: bar_width in (0,1], point dodge [0,1] times min spacing
statistics.category_argument: x remains categorical, y remains the value even in h
statistics.empty_levels: reserve slots, never invent estimates or legend entries
statistics.missing_rows: drop missing required rows; countplot needs no y
statistics.weighted_methods: mean with None or paired-row percentile bootstrap CI
statistics.unit_resampling: resample units, then rows within each selected unit
statistics.count_denominator: all usable selected rows across categories and hues

scatter_semantics.roles: independent hue/size/style, not inferred redundant grouping
scatter_semantics.scale_id: named figure pool, identical settings except legend
scatter_semantics.shared_rows: unique member rows in original table order
scatter_semantics.shared_guides: pooled scope guides, once per panel; dataset labels kept
scatter_semantics.shared_palette: one reserved colour block per name, legacy cannot shift
scatter_semantics.hue: categorical LCH slots or explicit numeric linear mapping
scatter_semantics.size: numeric/categorical diameters in points; native area=diameter**2
scatter_semantics.style: categorical unique filled markers; no cycling/repeating
scatter_semantics.orders: selected/reserved levels; missing rows drop listwise
scatter_semantics.norms: selected global bounds or explicit mapping-only clipped bounds
scatter_semantics.constant: numeric auto-constant maps midpoint, one numeric guide
scatter_semantics.legend: observed categories / numeric mapping guides, no plotted data
scatter_semantics.limits: primary2D numeric x/y; no group/c, colorbar, date/y2, outline
scatter_semantics.legacy: semantics=None leaves existing group/c/marker calls unchanged

lineplot.coordinates: numeric predictor x; horizontal swaps display only
lineplot.default: mean/seeded pointwise CI band; raw line primitive unchanged
lineplot.interval_scope: per-x cells, not simultaneous or whole-curve bootstrap
lineplot.sort: ascending default; False per-hue first observed x order
lineplot.bands: monotonic x; split at missing bounds, no fake singleton CI
lineplot.weights_units: shared mean/paired CI and within-x unit bootstrap
lineplot.axes: primary2D; raw/log predictors; explicit data/axis response fit
lineplot.semantics: independent raw hue/size/style tuples define curves
lineplot.size: sizes interpolate main stroke widths in points, not marker area
lineplot.style: unique filled markers; optional distinct named dashes
lineplot.shared: figure scale_id pools row domains; per-geometry guide blocks
lineplot.numeric_curves: clipping changes appearance, never merges raw curves
lineplot.limits: no categorical/date x, y2, dodge, callable/whole-curve CI

histogram.bins: pooled shared equal-width integer bins or explicit raw edges
histogram.membership: [left,right), final edge closed; outside mass excluded
histogram.weights: finite nonnegative paired rows; missing/zero weights dropped
histogram.normalization: in-bin mass: common_norm=True pooled, False per-curve
histogram.width: density/frequency divide raw data bin widths, not log widths
histogram.cumulative: count/mass sums; density integrates mass; no frequency
histogram.axes: primary2D v/h; positive raw observation log, linear heights
histogram.style: bars/hatches or unfilled steps/dashes; exact alpha/edge/width
histogram.step: native stairs; layer/stack only; edge_color overrides stroke
histogram.geometry: grouped stack/dodge keep heights; dodge splits raw bin width including reserved empty hues

kde.weights: nonnegative relative row mass, not sample replication
kde.bandwidth: unbiased weighted SD times factor*bw_adjust; effective n
kde.normalization: all usable selected mass, including singular hues
kde.clip: evaluation only; never trims fit rows or renormalizes tails
kde.common_grid: pooled weighted support, per-curve bandwidths retained
kde.cumulative: analytic full Gaussian CDF from -infinity, not ECDF
kde.singular: skip without fake bandwidth; warn_singular controls warning
kde.axes: primary2D v/h; positive raw/log observations + support
kde.density_units: raw data even on logs; linear density/CDF axis only
kde.style: line or fill; exact alpha/width; hue dash/hatch slots
kde.precision: scaled sums/covariance, bounded chunks; invalid derived fail

kde2d.weights: relative paired x/y row mass, not sample replication
kde2d.covariance: unbiased weighted full covariance, effective n
kde2d.normalization: all usable selected mass incl skipped singular hues
kde2d.support: cut/clip evaluation only; pooled grid, conditional fits
kde2d.levels: increasing enclosed HDR fractions conditional on grid mass
kde2d.quadrature: raw-coordinate trapezoidal nodes; ties all included
kde2d.level_precision: approximate grid HDR, not CI/full-space coverage
kde2d.singular: skip rank deficient, no jitter/regularization or fake fit
kde2d.axes: Cartesian2D raw x/y; positive observations + support on logs
kde2d.style: native contours/fill, exact alpha/outline, hue dash/hatch

ecdf.definition: right-continuous mass of X<=t; complement is X>t
ecdf.weights: finite nonnegative; count sums weights, not number of rows
ecdf.normalization: within each selected curve, not across hues
ecdf.rows: drop required missing and zero-weight rows before positivity
ecdf.ties: aggregate equal values into one full jump
ecdf.empty: no curve/legend; explicit hue order reserves color/style
ecdf.support: finite numeric; full jump at min; no tail extension
ecdf.axes: primary Cartesian2D; v/h; positive observation log, linear mass
ecdf.precision: scaled proportion sums; strict tails summed from the right
ecdf.unknown: reject ignored options; no fit/intervals/censoring/2-D ECDF

distribution_components.precedence: component overrides layer shorthand; body color keeps tiers
distribution_components.colors: hex RGB/RGBA, basic names, C0..C9 or none
distribution_components.hatch: body only; <=32 native symbols; empty disables redundant hatch
distribution_components.mean: requires showmeans=True; style does not infer visibility
distribution_components.hidden: reject styles for explicitly hidden median/fliers
distribution_components.unknown: reject unknown component/property keys; no arbitrary kwargs

violin.common_norm: area/count: across hues; False compares within hue
violin.area: common KDE density scale, not exact truncated polygon area
violin.count: peak-normalized profile times row count or weight mass / max
violin.weights: relative paired rows; unbiased covariance/effective n
violin.weighted_inner: inverse weighted ECDF quartiles; weighted mean
violin.weighted_rows: missing/zero rows dropped; no replication or sampling
violin.split: two selected/reserved hues; shared center; no positive dodge
violin.clip: increasing finite/None raw-value bounds; KDE support only
violin.inner_rows: point/stick <=10000 usable rows; no silent sampling
violin.singular: finite degenerate body, never invent a KDE or sample
violin.log: stat_scale controls fitted coordinates; clip stays raw units
violin.unknown_options: callable KDE and arbitrary inner_kws rejected

categorical_scales.native_order: select/reserve numeric positions, not physical reorder
categorical_scales.spacing: minimum selected/reserved spacing in axis coordinates
categorical_scales.native_log_category: positive levels; geometry in log10 coordinates
categorical_scales.stat_scale_axis: opt-in log10 summaries/KDE, inverse-map all artists
categorical_scales.legacy: ordinal and one-column one-based coordinates unchanged
categorical_scales.shared_axes: reject native/ordinal mixtures or conflicting scales

letter_values.quantiles: linear interpolation of usable raw observations per cell
letter_values.area_widths: probability mass / band height, normalized within cell
letter_values.zero_height_area: zero width; all-constant cells use exponential
letter_values.tail_points: raw rows strictly outside outer letter values, not IQR
letter_values.full_depth: outer endpoints are min/max, no tail points
letter_values.dodge: total hue span <=width; None auto, 0 overlays hues
letter_values.axes: Cartesian 2-D; ordinal or native numeric/log categories
letter_values.stat_scale: data default; axis opts into log10 quantiles/area heights
letter_values.missing_rows: listwise drop; empty slots have no invented summaries

swarm.packing: stable display-space greedy circles; repack every draw
swarm.category_scale: ordinal or native numeric/log; x remains category in h
swarm.dodge: total hue span <=width; None auto, 0 jointly packs hues
swarm.overcrowding: keep all rows at gutters; greedy packing is not optimal
swarm.warn_thresh: fraction in [0,1]; default 0.05; warn once per collection

paper.description: Balanced default; safe for up to 6 categories.

vivid.description: More saturated; safe for up to 6 categories.

soft.description: Muted/pastel; safe for up to 5 categories.
